brief: Tab of the panel beside a chat: the research brief the socio (AI agent) wrote.
computer: Tab of the panel: the socio's computer (its sandboxed machine); {{name}} is the socio's name.
socio: Stands in for the socio's name when there is none.
close: Accessible name of the X button that closes the panel.
computer-for: Label of the list that picks whose computer the panel shows.
no-socio: In the Computer tab of the panel beside a chat, when the workspace has no socio (AI agent) yet.
heading: Small capitals over the brief. _sample: an invented example brief.
download: Accessible name of the button that downloads the brief as a text file.
download-sources: Heading of the sources list in the downloaded text file.
sample-note: Notice over the example research brief shown before the socio has written a real one.
image: In place of an image in the brief (images aren't shown); {{alt}} is its description.
image-omitted: In place of an image without a description.
sources: Heading of the brief's sources, followed by how many.
fictional-source: Under a source of the example brief: it's invented, not a real page.
empty.title: Heading while there's no brief yet.
empty.text: Under it. _failed: the last run failed.
